title: Parcel shipping fee by weight
description: Bug report for the parcel shipping fee function, which takes the weight of a parcel in grams and returns the fee in cents. Parcels of exactly 1000 g and of exactly 5000 g are charged too much because the weight limits of the bands are treated as exclusive. Fix the program. The complete rule is: a weight below 1 gram is an error with the message "invalid weight"; 1 to 1000 grams cost 500; 1001 to 5000 grams cost 900; more than 5000 grams cost 1500.
notes: Two bugs of the same kind: both band limits use < instead of <=. Only the exact limits 1000 and 5000 fail; the visible examples (800, 3000) already pass on the start.
